name: V-Marc India Ltd.
summary: V-Marc India Ltd. is an Indian manufacturer and marketer of a diverse range of wires and cables, operating primarily within the electrical equipment industry. The company's core products include single-core and multi-core cables, low and high voltage power cables, control cables, communication cables such as LAN, CCTV, coaxial, and telephone cables, as well as flat cables and solar cables. These products are supplied to various sectors, including power distribution, infrastructure, real estate, telecom, and railways. V-Marc India serves both government and private clients, engaging in direct sales to institutional customers (B2B) and through a network of dealers and distributors (B2C) across India.
